physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: The only available implementation evidence is context/baseline.json; reports/ and build/ contain no feedback or candidate history. The qualified baseline (40, 0.55, 0, 0) has cell area 161954 um2, setup slack 0.19292 ns, hold slack 0.114491 ns, zero slew/capacitance/fanout violations, and modeled workload energies DOT64 2.293945631906608e-7 J, GEMM8 1.7792685987008622e-6 J, CONV3 1.1542462882162743e-6 J, giving normalized score 1.0. This previously untried tuple changes only abc_area to 1 to test area-oriented mapping against the cell-area-times-geometric-mean-energy objective. Keeping utilization 40 and density 0.55 isolates that change; reducing die area alone would not directly improve the specified score. Keeping repair_margin 0 is supported by the baseline electrical checks and avoids requesting additional repair margin without evidence of need. The small positive setup slack makes timing loss a material risk. Area and modeled-energy improvement remain hypotheses requiring the independent evaluator; this proposal makes no qualification or improvement claim and preserves all frozen implementation inputs and thresholds. Local schema, domain, and available-history checks passed; the required validation command could not complete because the supplied wrapper cannot import run_ppa_workflow_study, so the official gate remains unverified.
